comment: ESP32-H2 Zigbee sleepy end device. ONE endpoint (0x0a) carries everything: Basic (0x0000), Identify (0x0003), Power Configuration (0x0001, battery) and Occupancy Sensing (0x0406, the one 'awning protected' value). Single endpoint = single fingerprint, so deCONZ instantiates the ZHAPresence sensor cleanly on pair. manufacturername/modelid MUST match what the device reports on join (Phoscon -> device -> Basic cluster 0x0000, attrs 0x0004/0x0005). Kept as literals (not $-constants) so no generic constants file has to be deployed for the DDF to match.

items.name: state/presence
items.description: Awning protection state (true = protected / occupied). Phoscon 'Presence' card.

items.name: config/battery
items.description: Battery percentage via Power Configuration cluster. BatteryPercentageRemaining (0x0021) is half-percent, so /2.

items.name: config/sensitivity
items.description: Sensitivity = ADXL345 activity threshold, raw units 1-255 (Occupancy Sensing PIRUnoccupiedToOccupiedThreshold 0x0012); approx mg = value x 62.5. Lower = more sensitive. Writable at runtime; the device applies it to the accelerometer live and persists it in NVS. Sleepy ED: a write is queued and applied on the device's next wake.
